items.problem: `restore_purchases` does not say what it does when PaymentCore is not in the ready state (after a disconnection notification, line 107, or after a failed `prepare`). Line 144 has `recover_purchases` run `prepare` first, but line 162 only says that `restore_purchases` handles `list_owned` with transaction processing, and skipped transactions depend on the SKU table that `prepare` builds (line 155), so one implementation runs `prepare`, another calls `list_owned` without `connect`, and another returns `false`
